Definition: a longing; by implication, a delight (subjectively, satisfaction, objectively, a charm)
BiblicalUsage: 1) desire; 1a) desire, wish, longings of one's heart; 1a1) lust, appetite, covetousness (bad sense); 1b) thing desired, object of desire
